metadata.name: hex_vault
metadata.description: HexVault no-loss lottery with zero-sum hex rounds

accounts.name: pending_admin
docs: Checked in the handler against `pool.pending_admin`, so an unset
proposal fails with `NoPendingAdmin` instead of a constraint error.

accounts.name: current_epoch
docs: exist yet on the very first call (`pool.current_epoch_id == 0`); the
handler skips it entirely in that case, so it is never deserialized
before it exists.

accounts.name: epoch_two_behind
docs: deserialized) only when `pool.current_epoch_id >= 2`, i.e. when such
an epoch could exist at all. `saturating_sub` keeps the seed in range
on the two calls before that, where it is never read.

accounts.name: player
docs: Must already exist: a Player only has a cap to buy against once it
holds Principal.

instructions.name: close_round
docs: Permissionless (ops-and-envs ticket 05): reclaims a finished Round's
rent for the operator once every Position on it has settled.

instructions.name: cover_deficit
docs: Permissionless (ticket 10): pays USDC into the principal vault against
the recorded venue deficit, capped at it.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent only. The admin and operator come in through `params`.

accounts.name: weight_tree
docs: Created in the same transaction by a top-level
`system_program::create_account`, owned by this program and sized for
the header alone (zero nodes). `zero` refuses one already in use.

accounts.name: klend_program
docs: The venue program. klend: the klend program. kVault: the kVault program.
Stub: this program.

accounts.name: klend_market
docs: The venue market. klend: the lending market. kVault: the vault state
account. Stub: the pool PDA.

accounts.name: klend_reserve
docs: The venue reserve. klend: the reserve. kVault: the vault's shares mint.
Stub: the stub reserve PDA.

accounts.name: klend_ctoken
docs: The pool's position token account. klend: the pool's cToken account.
kVault: the pool's token account of the shares mint. Stub: the stub
vault PDA.

accounts.name: current_epoch
docs: when one is open (`pool.current_epoch_id != 0`); any account may be
passed before the first epoch begins, since there is nothing yet to
bound `ends_at` against.

instructions.name: deploy_to_venue
docs: Permissionless (yield-claimer ticket 05): syncs, then moves idle USDC
above the idle target into the venue. Venue-specific extra accounts go
in `remaining_accounts`.

accounts.name: weight_tree
docs: Grows by one node at this Player's first deposit, `owner` paying.

instructions.name: emergency_withdraw
docs: Permissionless, only valid once shut down (ops-and-envs ticket 03):
pays one Player's whole balance to their own USDC ATA.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Needed only while the pool is impaired. Leave it out otherwise.

accounts.name: player
docs: Must already exist, like `BuyTickets`': a Player only has a Principal
cap to grant against once it holds one.

instructions.name: harvest
docs: Permissionless (ticket 07): pays the yield fee owed to the Treasury and
the prize share owed to the jackpot vault.

accounts.name: player
docs: Seeded from its own `owner`, which is what makes this safe without a
signer: the destination below has to belong to that same owner.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Needed only while the pool is impaired, when this exit pays the haircut
value. Leave it out otherwise.

instructions.name: recall
docs: Permissionless (yield-claimer ticket 07): syncs, then redeems `amount`
from the venue while free idle is under the idle target.

instructions.name: request_draw
docs: Operator-only (ticket 08): snapshots the ended epoch's Ticket total and
its prize, then asks the VRF for the draw, or rolls the epoch over.

accounts.name: randomness
docs: against `vrf::randomness_address(&seed)` in the handler once the seed
is computed from the instruction's own `nonce` argument
(production-hardening ticket 02).

accounts.name: vrf_network_state
docs: `mut` because `request_v2` increments its `num_received`: the CPI marks
it writable, and an outer context that is not cannot grant that.

accounts.name: vrf_treasury
docs: rejects any other account, so it is only forwarded here.

accounts.name: randomness
docs: against `vrf::randomness_address` in the handler.

accounts.name: vrf_network_state
docs: `mut` because `request_v2` increments its `num_received`: the CPI marks
it writable, and an outer context that is not cannot grant that.

accounts.name: vrf_treasury
docs: rejects any other account, so it is only forwarded here.

instructions.name: request_withdraw
docs: Owner-signed (ADR 0020): the pending deposit part refunds in this
transaction, redeeming the gap from the venue when free idle is short.
The rest queues for `process_withdraw`.

accounts.name: randomness
docs: `vrf::randomness_address` in the handler the same way `draw` does.
Only read on the Drawing branch, where an unfulfilled (or absent)
account is the normal case.

instructions.name: set_buy_tickets_pause
docs: Admin-only. Stops `buy_tickets` while set (yield-claimer ticket 11).

instructions.name: set_deploy_pause
docs: Admin or Operator turns deploy off, only the Admin turns it back on
(yield-claimer ticket 10).

instructions.name: set_feature_pause
docs: Sets the game or the jackpot switch on its own (game-jackpot-pause
ticket 01), same role rule as `set_pause`.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Admin or operator. Which one is allowed depends on the direction, so
the handler checks it rather than a `has_one` here.

instructions.name: set_treasury_accounts
docs: Admin-only (ticket 07): sets `treasury` and `buyback_reserve`.

instructions.name: set_venue_params
docs: Admin-only (ticket 10): fee, idle band, caps, minimum size and loss
tolerance, each inside its program constant.

accounts.name: randomness
docs: against `vrf::randomness_address` (via `vrf::read_fulfilled`).

instructions.name: shutdown
docs: Admin-only and irreversible (ops-and-envs ticket 02, spec
"Shutdown"). Stops every inflow, the game and the draw, and lets
withdrawals skip the epoch lock.

instructions.name: sweep_house
docs: Admin-only, only valid once shut down (ops-and-envs ticket 04): moves
the jackpot's unreserved balance to `pool.treasury`.

accounts.name: randomness
docs: `vrf::randomness_address` in the handler the same way `settle_round`
does. It need not exist: an unfulfilled request is the normal case
here.

types.name: BuyTicketsPauseSet
docs: `set_buy_tickets_pause` flipped the Bought Tickets switch (yield-claimer
ticket 11).

fields.name: admin
docs: Role keys, not accounts: neither has to sign `create_pool`, and on
mainnet the admin is a multisig that cannot.

fields.name: base_rate_bps
docs: Ceiling on the depositor share, as an annual rate in basis points,
capped at `BPS_DENOMINATOR`. No floor.

fields.name: tickets_per_usdc
docs: Tickets credited per USDC spent in `buy_tickets`. Must be > 0.

fields.name: bonus_cap_bps
docs: Share of `total_principal`, in basis points, an operator
`grant_tickets` call may credit pool-wide per epoch. Capped at
`BPS_DENOMINATOR`.

fields.name: venue_kind
docs: A `constants::venue_kind` value: 0 klend, 1 stub (a `test-venue` build
only), 2 kVault. Which backing the four venue accounts belong to, and so
what each is: see `Pool::klend_program` to `klend_ctoken`. Refused unless
this build supports it. A kVault pool's four pins are checked against
the vault state (`VaultPinMismatch`, `VaultMintMismatch`,
`VaultStateUnreadable`).

types.name: DeficitCovered
docs: `cover_deficit` moved `amount` from `payer` into the principal vault
(ticket 10). `deficit` is what remains.

types.name: DeployPauseSet
docs: `set_deploy_pause` changed the deploy switch (ticket 10).

types.name: EmergencyWithdrawn
docs: Permissionless: `emergency_withdraw` paid one Player's whole balance to
its own USDC ATA once the pool was shut down. `total` is what was paid: all
of `principal`, which holds `pending` already, or the haircut value of it
while the pool is impaired (ticket 10).

types.name: Epoch
docs: One lottery cycle. Contiguous: the next opens the moment this one ends.

fields.name: status
docs: [`EpochStatus`]

fields.name: registered_weight
docs: The Weight tree's root for this epoch, snapshotted by `request_draw`:
every Player's Tickets at the epoch's end. The name is from before the
Weight tree, kept to hold the layout.

fields.name: jackpot_amount
docs: Jackpot vault balance snapshotted at the draw request.

fields.name: target
docs: Point in `registered_weight` selected by the draw.

fields.name: drawn_at
docs: When `draw` landed. 0 until then. `rollover_epoch` measures
`Pool.payout_timeout` from here.

fields.name: registration_opened_at
docs: When `begin_epoch` ended this epoch and started the next. 0 until then.
`rollover_epoch` measures `Pool.vrf_timeout` from the later of this
and `ends_at` for an epoch that was never sent to the draw.

fields.name: version
docs: Set to [`crate::constants::EPOCH_VERSION`] by `begin_epoch`. See
`Pool::version`.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Take new fields from here. Their zero value must be the safe default,
or bump `version` and migrate on first touch. See ADR 0013.

types.name: FeaturePaused
docs: `set_feature_pause` changed the game or the jackpot switch
(game-jackpot-pause ticket 01). `set_pause` keeps its own `Paused` event,
unchanged.

types.name: Harvested
docs: `harvest` paid the yield fee to the Treasury and the prize share to the
jackpot vault (ticket 07). `gain`, `fee`, `depositor_share` and
`prize_share` are the totals booked since the previous harvest. `fee_paid`
is `fee_owed` less any rounding dust the redeem cost, so it can be a few
units under what the pool owed. `prize_paid` is the whole prize owed.

types.name: HouseSwept
docs: Admin-only: `sweep_house` moved the jackpot's unreserved balance to
`pool.treasury` once the pool was shut down. Principal is never swept.

types.name: ImpairedCleared
docs: The recorded deficit reached zero and `impaired` cleared (ticket 10).
`deficit` is the deficit that stood before the step that cleared it. `cause`
is one of `impaired_cause`.

types.name: ImpairedSet
docs: A sync saw the venue's value fall past the loss tolerance and some of the
loss was left over after the prize share and the fee owed took theirs
(yield-claimer ticket 10). `loss` is the whole fall. `prize_absorbed` and
`fee_absorbed` are what those two owed amounts took. `deficit` is the
recorded deficit after, which includes any earlier one. Emitted again each
time a further loss grows it.

fields.name: compounded
docs: True for a non-House winner: the prize was moved into the principal
vault and added to the winner's Principal instead of paid to a token
account. Always false for a House win, which keeps its 50/30/20 split.

types.name: PauseFeature
docs: Which switch `set_feature_pause` changes (game-jackpot-pause ticket 01).
`set_pause`'s own `paused` field is untouched by either variant.

types.name: Player
docs: One wallet's account in one pool.

fields.name: principal
docs: 1:1 claim on deposited USDC. Never at risk.

fields.name: entries
docs: Tickets: lottery weight units, moved between players by the game.

fields.name: epoch_id
docs: The epoch `entries` belongs to. [`crate::touch::touch`] resets
`entries` to `principal` (pending deposit included) the first time the
Player is touched in a later epoch. The Weight tree holds range sums, not per-Player stamps,
so this lazy reset still lives here (ticket 02's progress note).

fields.name: pending_withdraw
docs: Queued by `request_withdraw` and waiting for `process_withdraw` to move
the USDC. A sub-balance of `principal`, which it leaves only when it
pays. 0 when nothing is queued.

fields.name: pending_epoch
docs: The epoch the pending amount was requested in. It pays out once
`pool.current_epoch_id` is past it.

fields.name: requested_at
docs: When `request_withdraw` booked the pending amount. The second way a
request matures, so a stalled operator who never calls `begin_epoch`
cannot freeze a depositor's money.

fields.name: bought_epoch
docs: The epoch `bought_amount` is counted against. `buy_tickets` resets
`bought_amount` to 0 when this no longer matches the pool's current
epoch.

fields.name: bought_amount
docs: USDC spent in `buy_tickets` so far in `bought_epoch`, capped at
`principal`.

fields.name: bonus_epoch
docs: The epoch `bonus_granted` is counted against. Separate from
`bought_epoch` so an operator grant and a bought-tickets purchase
don't share a cap.

fields.name: bonus_granted
docs: Tickets an operator `grant_tickets` call has credited this Player so
far in `bonus_epoch`, capped at `principal`. An admin grant does not
count against it.

fields.name: yield_index
docs: `Pool.yield_index` at this Player's last settle (ADR 0017).

fields.name: leaf_index
docs: This Player's 1-based Leaf in the Weight tree, assigned at first
deposit by ticket 08. 0 means no Leaf yet.

fields.name: version
docs: Set to [`LAYOUT_VERSION`] by `Player::init_if_fresh` and
`create_pool`. See `Pool::version`.

fields.name: pending_deposit
docs: Principal deposited in `pending_deposit_epoch` that has earned no Ticket
yet. A sub-balance of `principal`, not an addition to it. [`crate::touch::touch`]
folds it into `entries` and zeroes it on the first touch in a later epoch

fields.name: pending_deposit_epoch
docs: The epoch of the latest deposit. Its Tickets count from the next one.

fields.name: open_positions
docs: Positions this Player has bought and not yet settled. `buy_position`
raises it and `settle_position` lowers it. `process_withdraw` refuses
while it is above zero, so a stake on the board can never come back to a
Player whose Principal has already left.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Take new fields from here. Their zero value must be the safe default,
or bump `version` and migrate on first touch. See ADR 0013. Smaller
than `Pool`'s: Player rent is paid by the depositor.

types.name: Pool
docs: One deployed instance of the product: one accepted mint, one principal
vault, one jackpot vault, one epoch schedule.

fields.name: admin
docs: Changes parameters, unpauses, rotates the operator, and hands its own
role on. A multisig on mainnet.

fields.name: operator
docs: The hot key the operator service cranks with. Also the House Player's
owner and, on devnet, the mint authority.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Proposed next admin. `Pubkey::default()` means no handover is open.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Token account that takes 20% of a jackpot the House wins.

fields.name: buyback_reserve
docs: Token account that takes 50% of a jackpot the House wins.

fields.name: house
docs: The House `Player` PDA, created in `create_pool`.

fields.name: vrf_network_state
docs: ORAO VRF network state, pinned at pool creation.

fields.name: epoch_seconds
docs: Applies to the next epoch created, not the open one.

fields.name: epoch_anchor
docs: Fixes the phase of the epoch grid `epoch_anchor + k * epoch_seconds`.
Every epoch boundary is a point on it, so the draw lands at the same
clock time whatever second the pool was bootstrapped on.

fields.name: round_seconds
docs: Applies to the next round created, not the open one.

fields.name: close_buffer
docs: Positions stop this many seconds before a round ends.

fields.name: vrf_timeout
docs: Seconds after a randomness request before void / rollover is allowed.

fields.name: house_cut_bps
docs: Share of every settled round pot credited to the House, in basis
points, 0..=10_000. Applies to the next round settled.

fields.name: current_epoch_id
docs: 0 before the first epoch.

fields.name: current_epoch_ends_at
docs: End of the current epoch, copied from its `Epoch.ends_at`, so changing
`epoch_seconds` never moves an epoch that has already begun. Nothing in
the tree or `touch` reads it since ticket 19.

fields.name: previous_epoch_start
docs: Start of the epoch before the current one. Usually that is
`current_epoch_start` too, except when `begin_epoch` skipped a gap.

fields.name: previous_epoch_ends_at
docs: End of the epoch before the current one.

fields.name: open_round_id
docs: 0 when no round is Open or Requested.

fields.name: pending_withdrawals
docs: Σ `Player.pending_withdraw` across the pool. USDC the principal vault
holds for queued withdrawals, which no other payout may spend. Part of
`total_principal`, not a second claim beside it.

fields.name: min_jackpot
docs: An epoch whose jackpot vault holds less than this at the draw request
rolls over instead of paying out dust.

fields.name: payout_timeout
docs: Seconds after `Epoch.drawn_at` before a Drawn epoch may be rolled
over unpaid. The escape hatch for a winner nobody can pay.

fields.name: jackpot_reserved
docs: Jackpot already promised to an epoch that is Drawing or Drawn and has
not paid yet. The draw request snapshots the vault minus this, so the
next epoch cannot take a prize the previous one still owes. Released
on `payout` and on either branch of `rollover_epoch`.

fields.name: base_rate_bps
docs: The ceiling on the depositor share of a venue gain, as an annual rate on
`total_principal` in basis points, capped at `BPS_DENOMINATOR`. Gain
above it goes to the prize share (ADR 0017). It has no floor: at zero
every gain above the Yield fee goes to the prize share.

fields.name: tickets_per_usdc
docs: Tickets credited per USDC spent in `buy_tickets`. An admin parameter,
always greater than zero.

fields.name: bonus_cap_bps
docs: Share of `total_principal`, in basis points, an operator
`grant_tickets` call may credit pool-wide per epoch. An admin
parameter, capped at `BPS_DENOMINATOR`.

fields.name: bonus_epoch
docs: The epoch `bonus_granted` is counted against, reset the same way as
`Player.bought_epoch`/`bought_amount`.

fields.name: bonus_granted
docs: Tickets an operator `grant_tickets` call has credited pool-wide so far
in `bonus_epoch`, capped at `total_principal * bonus_cap_bps /
10_000`. An admin grant does not count against it.

fields.name: version
docs: Set to [`LAYOUT_VERSION`] by `create_pool`. Lets a future upgrade
tell an old account apart from a freshly created one and migrate it
lazily on first touch.

fields.name: shutdown
docs: Admin-only and irreversible (spec "Shutdown"). Stops every inflow,
the game and the draw, and lets withdrawals skip the epoch lock.

fields.name: game_paused
docs: Stops `create_round` and `buy_position` (game-jackpot-pause ticket
01). `create_pool` sets this `true`.

fields.name: jackpot_paused
docs: Stops the epoch cycle's next step: `begin_epoch`, `buy_tickets` and
`grant_tickets` (game-jackpot-pause ticket 01). An epoch already
Drawing or Drawn still finishes. `create_pool` sets this `true`.

fields.name: weight_tree
docs: The pool's [`WeightTree`] account, created at `create_pool`.

fields.name: klend_program
docs: The four pinned venue accounts. The names are klend's and stay, because
renaming a field breaks every client's IDL; what each one is depends on
`venue_kind`. `create_pool` takes them (never the default key) and every
venue instruction checks its accounts against them.
Venue program. klend: the klend program. kVault: the kVault program.
Stub: this program.

fields.name: klend_market
docs: Venue market. klend: the lending market. kVault: the vault state
account (a deposit and a redeem write it, so the client passes it
writable). Stub: the pool PDA.

fields.name: klend_reserve
docs: Venue reserve. klend: the reserve. kVault: the vault's shares mint.
Stub: the stub reserve PDA.

fields.name: klend_ctoken
docs: The pool's position token account. klend: the pool's cToken account.
kVault: the pool's token account of the shares mint. Stub: the stub
vault PDA.

fields.name: yield_index
docs: Depositor share per unit of Principal, scaled by 1e18. Only rises.

fields.name: venue_value
docs: The venue position's value at the last sync, and when that was.

fields.name: yield_owed
docs: Depositor yield the index has credited and no Player has settled.

fields.name: fee_owed
docs: Yield fee owed to the Treasury, paid out by harvest.

fields.name: prize_owed
docs: Prize share owed to the jackpot vault, paid out by harvest.

fields.name: deficit
docs: Venue loss not yet repaid. Nonzero only while `impaired`.

fields.name: yield_fee_bps
docs: The team's share of every gain, at most `MAX_YIELD_FEE_BPS`.

fields.name: idle_floor_bps
docs: Idle band: free idle USDC as a share of the pool. The program never
reads the floor. The Operator recalls when free idle is under it. Deploy
moves idle above the target.

fields.name: reserve_share_cap_bps
docs: Deploy cap: the pool's largest share of the reserve's supply.

fields.name: reserve_liquidity_floor_bps
docs: Deploy cap: free liquidity the reserve must keep after a deploy, as a
multiple of the pool's position in basis points (20_000 is twice it).

fields.name: min_venue_move
docs: Smallest deploy or recall, in USDC atomic units.

fields.name: loss_tolerance_bps
docs: A fall in venue value past this share of it is a venue loss.

fields.name: deploy_paused
docs: Stops deploy. Either key sets it, only the Admin clears it.

fields.name: impaired
docs: Set by a venue loss, cleared when `deficit` reaches zero.

fields.name: buy_tickets_paused
docs: Stops `buy_tickets` (ADR 0019). Admin-only setter in ticket 11.

fields.name: harvest_gain
docs: Running totals of every gain booked since the last harvest, for the
harvest event (yield-claimer ticket 07). `apply_sync` adds to them,
`harvest` reads and zeroes them. They are not claims: only the owed
amounts above are.

fields.name: epoch_start_principal
docs: `total_principal` as it stood when `begin_epoch` opened the current
epoch. The pool-wide cap on operator grants reads it, so a deposit made
mid-epoch cannot widen the cap. Zero before epoch 1, which refuses
operator grants until an epoch exists.

fields.name: venue_kind
docs: Which backing the four pinned venue keys point at, a
`constants::venue_kind` value: 0 klend, 1 stub (localnet only), 2 kVault.
Zero is klend, so a pool made before the byte existed reads as klend.
`create_pool` sets it.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Take new fields from here. Their zero value must be the safe default,
or bump `version` and migrate on first touch. See ADR 0013.

types.name: PoolShutdown
docs: Admin-only and irreversible (spec "Shutdown"). Stops every inflow, the
game and the draw, and lets withdrawals skip the epoch lock.

types.name: Position
docs: A Player's single immutable placement in one round.

fields.name: tiles
docs: Bitmask, bits 0..35.

fields.name: version
docs: Set to [`LAYOUT_VERSION`] by `buy_position`.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Take new fields from here. See ADR 0013.

fields.name: reward
docs: Stake back plus the share of the losers' pot, for a winner.

fields.name: refund
docs: The whole stake returned as Tickets on a voided round (ADR 0019).

types.name: Round
docs: One 60 second game on the 36-tile hex board.

fields.name: status
docs: [`RoundStatus`]

fields.name: pot
docs: Entries staked in this round. Stays gross: the House cut is never
subtracted from it.

fields.name: house_cut
docs: Entries taken out of `pot` for the House at settlement. 0 until then,
and on forfeited or voided rounds.

fields.name: open_positions
docs: Positions bought on this round still open (not yet settled).
Incremented in `buy_position`, decremented when `settle_position`
closes its Position. `close_round` refuses while this is nonzero.

fields.name: vrf_request_slot
docs: Slot `request_round_randomness` landed in. 0 until then.

fields.name: version
docs: Set to [`LAYOUT_VERSION`] by `create_round`.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Take new fields from here. See ADR 0013.

types.name: RoundClosed
docs: Permissionless: `close_round` reclaimed a finished Round's rent for
`pool.operator` once every Position on it had settled.

fields.name: pot
docs: Gross: the House cut has not been subtracted from it.

fields.name: forfeited
docs: True when nobody covered the winning tile and the pot went to the House.

fields.name: house_cut
docs: Entries taken out of `pot` for the House. 0 on a forfeited round.

types.name: Synced
docs: A sync saw the venue's value rise and split the gain (yield-claimer
ticket 05). `fee + depositor_share + prize_share + deficit_repaid` is the
gain; a recorded deficit is repaid before any split (ticket 10). Not emitted
for a sync that saw no gain, or that ran in the same second as the last.

fields.name: by_admin
docs: True for the uncapped admin path; false for the capped operator path.

types.name: TreasuryAccountsSet
docs: Admin-only: `set_treasury_accounts` replaced the Treasury and the buyback
reserve (ticket 07).

types.name: VenueDeployed
docs: `deploy_to_venue` moved `amount` of idle USDC into the venue.
`venue_value` is the pool's recorded venue value afterwards.

types.name: VenueParamsSet
docs: Admin-only: `set_venue_params` changed the venue settings (ticket 10).
Carries every value as it stands afterwards.

types.name: VenueRecalled
docs: `recall` moved `amount` of USDC from the venue back into the principal
vault (yield-claimer ticket 07). `venue_value` is the recorded value after.

types.name: WeightTree
docs: Header of the pool's Fenwick weight tree (ADR 0018). The nodes follow it
in the same account, `node_count` of them, `node_size` bytes each,
starting 8-aligned right after this header. `create_pool` sizes the
account for zero nodes; ticket 08 grows it by one node per first deposit.
Created by a top-level `system_program::create_account` in the
`create_pool` transaction, owned by this program and zeroed, because an
in-program create is capped at 10 KiB and the tree may pass that.

fields.name: version
docs: [`crate::constants::WEIGHT_TREE_VERSION`].

fields.name: node_size
docs: [`WEIGHT_TREE_NODE_SIZE`].

fields.name: pool
docs: The `Pool` this tree belongs to.

fields.name: amount
docs: This request alone, the refunded part and the queued part together.

fields.name: pending
docs: Everything the player now has waiting, this request included.

fields.name: refunded
docs: The part that was a pending deposit and paid at once (ADR 0020).

fields.name: paid
docs: What reached the owner for the refund. Under `refunded` while the pool
is impaired.

fields.name: redeemed
docs: What the refund took from the venue to cover free idle.

types.name: Withdrawn
docs: A `Withdrawn` event follows once `process_withdraw` moves the USDC. Its
`amount` is what was paid, under the request while the pool is impaired.
